checklist: Subdomain is registered with the gateway (else it isn't routed) — VERIFY ONLY: registration is performed by DevOps or the platform team, never by an agent. Unregistered -> report it and hand DevOps the values; do not register it yourself
App is reachable only through the gateway in production (no public ingress of its own)
The app's own public paths (if any) are under /dangerously-skip-login/**; everything else is login-required

The gateway probe paths /health, /api/health, /version, /api/version (exact match) are implemented, answer without a session, and read no identity — these are unauthenticated by gateway design and are never a violation

Access mode is as intended (owners-only / access list / everyone) — VERIFY ONLY: it is set at /auth/ui/apps by DevOps or an authorized owner. Wrong mode -> report the intended value and who must change it; never change it yourself
Identity is read from X-User-Id (server) or /auth/api/me (browser)
No custom login/session/JWT handling for gateway auth
Roles/permissions (if any) are keyed by email and enforced in the app
X-Request-Id is logged and propagated to downstream calls
Login uses full-page navigation to /auth/ui/login; no SPA route claims /auth/**
Dev-only X-User-Id injection and mock login are disabled in production builds
Logout uses full-page /auth/logout (or POST /auth/api/logout for cookie-only clear)
